candidates.title: Massachusetts DOT approves funding for new MBTA locomotives
candidates.excerpt: BOSTON — The Massachusetts Department of Transportation on Wednesday (Sept. 23) approved $200 million in funding for new Massachusetts Bay Transportation Authority commuter rail equipment, part of $600 million approved by the MassDOT board of directors for three major projects. candidates.excerpt: Ammonia is increasingly emerging as one of the potential fuels for decarbonising deep-sea shipping, but moving from early projects to widespread commercial adoption will require progress across infrastructure, regulation, production costs and workforce readiness. For Baert, the timeline facing the industry is significant. As she put it, 2050 is effectively “one ship lifetime away”, reflecting the long investment cycles involved in shipping and the time required for major changes across the fleet. (ICTSI) has secured a US$1 billion term loan facility from BDO Unibank as the global terminal operator continues its major investment programme across its international portfolio. candidates.title: APM Terminals Pipavav launches first double-stack Python train to Dadri
candidates.excerpt: APM Terminals Pipavav has launched its first double-stack Python block train to ICD Dadri, expanding container rail connectivity between western and northern India. The inaugural service departed Pipavav on 16 September, carrying 338 TEUs over a distance of around 1,200 kilometres. The operation was carried out in collaboration with Maersk India and Container Corporation of India (CONCOR). New service increases container capacity The service uses a double-stack Python configuration, which allows more containers to be transported in a single rail movement. According to APM Terminals Pipavav, the configuration can carry up to four times the volume of its existing weekly import block train. The terminal said this was the first Python rake designed and operated by a port for a single shipping line. The operation involved APM Terminals Pipavav, Maersk India, CONCOR and Indian Railways. candidates.excerpt: India's exporters struggling with shortage of empty boxes at JNPA Indian container trade stakeholders at JNPA (Nhava Sheva Port) are reporting a growing shortage of ... Hapag-Lloyd has cut contracted capacity allocations under its Quality Freight Product (QFP) service by as much as 40%, according to one forwarder, raising questions over the flexibility of the carrier’s guaranteed-capacity offering amid the disruption in Asia. candidates.excerpt: Private credit steady as private equity rebounds Private credit remained steady in the second quarter of 2026, while private equity rebounded, according to new research by index provider MSCI. candidates.title: Greenbrier racks up $600 million in new railcar orders
candidates.excerpt: Freight car builder Greenbrier received orders for 3,400 new railcars worth about $600 million during its fiscal fourth quarter, including a 780-car order from Saudi Railway Company that expands the manufacturer’s relationship with the state-owned rail operator into intermodal equipment. Lake Oswego, Ore,-based Greenbrier (NYSE: GBX) said that the orders were booked in the quarter ended Aug. 31 and cover several railcar types and end markets. The company said the volume provides a foundation as it enters fiscal 2027. The orders represent a mix of new and replacement fleets across several care types, Vice President of Marketing and General Manager Thomas Jackson told FreightWaves. They include hoppers, flatcars, tank cars, boxcars/refrigerated cars and gondolas. The orders are spread evenly across railroads, shippers and operating lessors, he added. candidates.title: Weekly U.S. rail traffic back above 2025 levels
candidates.excerpt: WASHINGTON — Intermodal traffic was the key as U.S. weekly rail traffic rebounded to above 2025 levels for the week ending Sept. 19, 2026. Figures from the Association of American Railroads show overall volume for the week was 535,663 carloads and intermodal units, up 4.9% from the same week a year ago. That includes 234,207 carloads, an increase of 2.4% from a year ago, and 301,456 containers and trailers, a gain of 6.9%. The previous week, traffic had been down 3.7% compared to the same week in 2025 earlier, the first time that volume had been below 2025 levels since the week of Feb. 7. For the year to date, traffic is 18,921,181 carloads and intermodal units, an increase of 3.4% over the first 37 weeks of 2025. That includes 8,444,095 carloads, up 2.7%, and 10,477,086 intermodal units, up 4.1%. candidates.excerpt: LOS ANGELES — The first of four Wabtec FLXdrive battery-electric locomotives for Union Pacific have arrived in Southern California to begin testing, UP has announced. Two of the units are now on hand, with two more to arrive in October. candidates.excerpt: BERLIN – Progress Rail is showcasing its new EMD SD70H hybrid locomotive technology — which can reduce fuel consumption by up to 30% — at InnoTrans 2026. Built on the SD70 platform, the SD70H combines traditional diesel-electric power with battery-assisted energy management to reduce fuel consumption, improve operating efficiency, and lower total cost of ownership while integrating seamlessly into existing fleets, the manufacturer says. candidates.title: Importers push back on CBP supply chain data proposals
candidates.excerpt: Importers push back on CBP supply chain data proposals Hapag-Lloyd champions IoT container telemetry but importers – and factory data – highlight practical flaws of mandatory paper trails. US Customs and Border Protection’s (CBP) proposal to mandate heightened supply-chain data disclosures to boost cargo security is drawing sharp pushback from importers. While ocean carriers see an opportunity to leverage advanced technology, importers warn that foreign paper trails are often non-existent – a gap highlighted by recent data straight from Chinese factory hubs. In response to proposals in an Advance Notice of Proposed Rulemaking issued by CBP earlier this month, ocean carrier Hapag-Lloyd urged the agency to move beyond traditional paper declarations.
